set.body: Evolve Sampled[F,D,A,Role,R] as a semantic layer over Ravel NDArray[A,R], never as a competing multidimensional array. Add fast ranked access for common image coordinates, zero-copy spatial, time, channel, and component views where the layout permits them, explicit materialization otherwise, and internal iteration paths that preserve Ravel kernel performance. Keep geometry and non-spatial-axis metadata coupled to values while storage, strides, and kernels remain owned by Ravel. Acceptance: common (i,j,k) and (i,j,k,t) access is direct and allocation-free; view and copy behavior is explicit and tested; no wrapper stack appears in hot loops; JVM and Scala.js suites and the frozen evidence court pass.
set.title: Make image4s the zero-overhead dense sampled-image layer
